lessons.lesson: Per-panel image/text-bounds checks can pass while actual visible boxes overlap or whole-page geometry has large holes. Pairwise visible-box and page-wide empty-band checks catch different failures; exact rendered-page review is still required.

Suppressing comic speaker labels needs an exact tail/off-panel attribution review. Compact source-specific caption lanes are preferable to covering eyes, contact or the feast when the original strip has no quiet lettering space.

Added detail panels should have an expressive or physical story purpose. Repeated enlarged soft fin crops feel like padding; an existing speaker reaction plus one narrow action detail uses the same source art more effectively.
